source-checked.eventDescription: One valid public source check (one query or app ID in one country), $2 per 1,000 checks. Paid when filters, exclusions or a valid empty/not-found response leave zero rows. Failed or blocked responses and invalid input are not charged. No start fee; proxy and compute are included. maxSources limits attempted targets. maxTotalChargeUsd is the Apify run option for a dollar cap, not an input field.

app.eventDescription: One delivered app; row keys app_id, country, name, developer, rating, rating_count, version, price, currency, url. $0.5 per 1,000 rows plus the source-check fee. Filtered, duplicate and excluded rows have no row fee. No start fee; proxy and compute are included. One query/country returning three rows costs $0.0035 total; ID lookups return at most one row per country.
